context: Daichi takes Sho on a country day trip.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、本当、いい一日や。
lines.en: Sho, that really was a good day.
lines.style: Kansai lilt threading through warmth. Soft opening attack on the name. Genuine, unhurried appreciation. Tender undercurrent — this moment matters. Real affection without performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine voice. Quiet conviction on the agreement. Soft brightness — not performing happiness, feeling it. The ease of being with someone safe.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Being together like this — it really makes me happy.
lines.style: Kansai rhythm and warmth. Slow, deliberate pace. Each phrase gets its own breath. Tender and full — this is the heart of what he's saying. No rush to move past it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: We both really gave it our all.
lines.style: Small voice with quiet strength underneath. Soft but certain — he's noticed the effort. Warm recognition, not praise from above. Speaking as an equal in this thing they did together.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: And we'll keep going forward together.
lines.style: Kansai warmth softening into a promise. Slow, deliberate close. Tender weight on the last phrase — he means this. Breath trailing off gently, like settling into something true.
